_about: How each art direction from the design-taste library moves on film. Loom's director deals a direction, then the storyboard may only use that direction's scenes, in its pace, with its transition. Scenes and their slots are described in scenes.json.

name-as-monument.film: The name is the event: it arrives huge and cropped by the frame edge, everything else is small and brief.

sentence-as-layout.film: One sentence carries the film: it is set huge and breaks across shots, proof arrives between its halves.

pinned-poster.film: A poster that rebuilds itself: one frame holds while words and the product swap through it.

colour-chapters.film: Each idea gets its own flat field of colour; the film is a run of chapters.

place-carries-it.film: The product's own screen is the place; slow crossfades and long holds on the picture.

page-is-the-object.film: Treat the product like a printed object: framed screens, captions like a catalogue.

one-motif.film: One device repeats: the same rise and the same field return in every shot, so the film feels like one gesture.

product-performs.film: The product does the talking: real screens and real commands, words only as captions.

quiet-instrument.film: Precise and calm: small type, exact numbers, long holds, nothing shouts.

hero-object.film: One picture is the hero and opens like a shutter; everything else waits for it.

specimen-catalogue.film: A catalogue of parts: the tools and features flash past like a type specimen.

borrowed-category.film: Borrow the look of another genre (a ticker, a headline, a marquee) and run the product through it.

contact-sheet.film: Many quick frames of the real product, then one held still.

editorial-report.film: Report the facts like a front page: a headline, the numbers, the proof.

loud-flat-poster.film: Loud, flat, fast: fields of colour, heavy type, hard cuts on the beat.

split-stage.film: Two halves in conversation: the product on one side, the words on the other.

dense-tiles.film: Dense and technical: many facts, tight pace, terminal and numbers.

uneven-photographs.film: Pictures at different sizes and paces, words kept small between them.

dark-room.film: Dark, slow and luxurious: one light source, long holds, quiet type.

type-only-statement.film: No pictures: the claim, the number and the name, set as type and nothing else.
